item.description:
Bouncebin 1.2.0

  • Collect masters. A playlist you are happy with is the start of a record, not the end of one — so there is now a button in the album view that goes and finds the wav or aiff behind each song and copies it, in running order, into a folder you pick. It tells you what it found and how big it is before it copies anything, and it is honest about the songs where only a lossy bounce survives.
  • Shortcuts to the projects. The same folder gets a Projects folder holding a shortcut to the Logic, Ableton or Reaper project behind each song, and a Running order file saying which file each track came from. Open the folder in three months and it still explains itself.
  • Nothing is moved and no original is touched — these are copies. A bounce that lives only in iCloud is fetched, copied, and handed back to iCloud exactly as it was.
  • The details panel is reachable from a playlist again. The arrow that opens it had been falling onto a line of its own below each row, where it no longer looked like part of the song. Same panel, same paths, same Show in Finder and Open project.
